comic_claim: Ancient wisdom arrives in a culture optimized to avoid all discomfort, and gets treated as a disturbance.
comic_model: The Buddha as the neighbor nobody wants.

derivations.premise: Happy family picnic; skinny Buddha in a rag appears: the first noble truth is suffering. Parents scoot the kids away.
Monk achieves enlightenment, immediately checks likes: 10,000 unread notifications from the monastery app.
Reincarnation explained as a content-moderation queue: most souls pending review.

facts.claim: The first noble truth of Buddhism is dukkha: suffering exists.
Modern wellness culture sells the elimination of all discomfort.

reality_model: A 2,500-year-old diagnosis meets a comfort-maximizing culture.
